words.text: Deep in the forest, they came to call him back.
The rite wants three Wards, laid on one level.
Two, four paces apart, on a straight line.
The third, two paces aside from their middle.
Seen from above, a roof: two slopes and a flat base.
Then cast Morsmordre at any one of the three.
If the shape is true, the Mark answers.
...he rises where the three lines meet.
For his first five seconds, no spell can harm him.
What the rite calls is not to be met unprepared.
